headline: Archies Limited announces newspaper notice for postal ballot
hook: Shareholders to vote via postal ballot
summary: Archies Limited filed a press release with the NSE on November 4, 2026 stating that a newspaper will publish the notice of a postal ballot. The notice relates to a forthcoming shareholder voting process. The filing satisfies regulatory requirements and does not impact the company's operations. It is relevant for shareholders who intend to participate in the ballot.
why_it_matters: Shareholders must act on ballot notice

headline: Archies Limited announces postal ballot process
hook: Archies seeks shareholder approval via postal ballot
summary: Archies Limited has officially notified the stock exchange regarding the commencement of a postal ballot process. This procedure allows shareholders to vote on company resolutions without attending a physical meeting. The specific agenda items for the ballot were not detailed in the initial exchange filing. Shareholders should review the upcoming notice for details on the proposals being put to a vote.
whats_next: Release of the detailed postal ballot notice
why_it_matters: Shareholders must review ballot proposals to understand potential corporate changes.

headline: Archies appoints Anant Gupta as non-executive independent director
hook: New independent director joins Archies board
summary: Archies Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Anant Gupta as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective November 2, 2026. The regulatory filing informs the National Stock Exchange of this board-level change. Such routine governance updates have negligible immediate financial impact on the company's stock performance. Indian retail investors tracking micro-cap corporate governance will note this compliance update.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no immediate financial impact for shareholders.
